in_marathi.name: Mishita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of death, Mṛtasā
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mishita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Mishita originated from the Sanskrit term Mṛtasā, meaning the goddess of death. In Hindu mythology, Mṛtasā is believed to be the one who welcomes the deceased to the other world. Thus, this name is associated with the profound and spiritual meaning of life and death.
